build_point_head: build a point head module from config using build_point_head with cfg and input_channels
compute_roi_mask_point_loss: compute the point-based binary cross entropy loss for instance segmentation mask predictions
create_standard_point_head: create a StandardPointHead MLP using conv1d layers with fine-grained and coarse features as input
create_implicit_point_head: create an ImplicitPointHead MLP that uses instance-wise parameters and positional encoding for mask prediction
register_point_head: register a custom point head class in the POINT_HEAD_REGISTRY for use with build_point_head
